seoTitle: Integrate Square with Squarespace as a Payment Option
metaDescription: Connect Square to your Squarespace store to accept payments, sync sales, and manage checkout in one place. Step-by-step setup for 2026.
intro: Connecting Square to Squarespace lets you accept payments securely while keeping online and in-person sales in sync. This guide covers linking the two platforms from your Squarespace dashboard, so checkout runs smoothly for your customers.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in to your Squarespace account and select the website you want to connect Square to from your dashboard.

steps.heading: Open Selling settings
steps.body: In your site dashboard, go to Settings, then Selling, then Payments — this is where you manage how your store accepts money.

steps.heading: Choose Square as your payment processor
steps.body: Click the Square option in the list of providers, then log in with your Square business credentials to authorize the connection.

steps.heading: Confirm the connection
steps.body: Once you sign in, Squarespace automatically links your Square account, syncing it for use at checkout.

steps.heading: Test your checkout
steps.body: Visit your site's checkout page and run a test order or review the payment options to confirm Square is working correctly.

faq.question: Why connect Square to Squarespace instead of using just one platform?
faq.answer: Square adds real-time sales tracking, easy refunds, and POS integration, which is useful if you sell both online and in person.

faq.question: Do I need a Square account before starting?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll need Square credentials tied to your business to complete the login and authorization step.

faq.question: Will my existing Squarespace payment methods still work?
faq.answer: Square is added as an option alongside your existing payment methods, so customers can choose from whatever you've enabled.

faq.question: How do I know the integration is working?
faq.answer: Run a test transaction or check the payment method list at checkout to confirm Square shows up as an active option.
